name: Koil
tagline: A mint-green corridor, a handful of keys, and whoever walks in with you.
description:
You wake up in a small tiled hall with a checkerboard floor that brightens as it recedes, mint walls with dark windows, and a few things sitting on the ground: a line of keys, a bomb. Walk, turn, pick them up. Space throws the bomb; it bounces, rings off the walls, and bursts into sparks.

Send the invite and the same hall is a room. Other people show up as little silhouettes down the corridor, picking up what you have not yet reached, tossing bombs of their own.

On a phone, the left thumb walks and the right thumb looks; tap Throw for the bomb. On a computer it is WASD or the arrows, and Space.

An unofficial port of Koil by tsoding.
